headline: Nasdaq Jumps More Than 1%; Comcast Shares Spike Higher
summary: US stocks higher, Nasdaq up 1%. Dow up 0.60%, Nasdaq up 1.34%, S&P 500 up 0.82%. Communication services shares jump 2.3%, materials down 1%. Comcast up 10%.

headline: Iridium Communications, FuelCell Energy, Rocket Lab And Other Big Stocks Moving Higher On Monday
summary: Dow Jones gains 350 points, Iridium acquired by Rocket Lab for $8B, big stocks recording gains: QuidelOrtho, FuelCell, Ouster, Viasat, Swarmer, Charter, Prime Medicine, Roblox, Satellogic, Churchill Capital, Rocket Lab.
